lines.en: My shell is a layer thicker than the others'.
I walk at the front of the column.
My steps land with weight.
My horns are longer than the others'.
I scan the grass on both sides.
The column follows behind me.
I pause so the rear can catch up.

lines.zh: 我踏过一片被踩坏的草
lines.en: I cross a patch of crushed grass.
I am unhurried; I take the outside.
My plates look dark in the red light.
My mandibles are wider than the others'.
I check the ground the whole way.
My shadow holds the grass down.
I lead in and I leave last.
My steps are measured, as if counting.
My plates grate against each other.
I stand with antennae still.
My place is at the front.
I listen to tremors in the ground.
The small ones are restless behind.
I open and close my mandibles twice.
One old wound marks my shell.
I lift my head and look far off.
I am not at ease.
I block a stretch of the wind.
Someone hauls things at the nest.
I guard the nest mouth with wings unfolded.
The grass moves; I look at once.
I draw my gaze back again.
I block the road ahead of the column.
You are taller, but I do not yield.
You do not belong in this crimson.

lines.zh: 我的壳上有伤，也有力气
lines.en: My shell bears wounds, and strength.
Those behind are mine to guard.
Your hand rests at your waist.
I counted your steps.
To pass, you go through me.
Fluid seeps from the cracks in my shell.
I give ground and immediately hold.
I clench my mandibles.
One leg has gone weak.
A plate on my back has loosened.
Someone behind me is calling.
I do not give way.
Blood seeps from the seam.
My feet are still planted.
What you hold is beneath my notice.

lines.zh: 你举着的东西我没兴趣。
lines.en: What you hold up does not interest me.
There is a column behind me.
That would not go around.
I step back, but not from fear.
Take it away.

lines.zh: 这里不是做买卖的地方
lines.en: This is no place for trade.

lines.zh: 我的活儿比吃东西要紧
lines.en: My duty matters more than eating.
I hold you and will not let you past.
My shell hits like stone.
I do not yield; you did.
That turned me half a step.
My mandibles have opened.
Our shells knock together.
I must hold my position.
You trod on my foreleg.
The ones behind press forward too.
I am not moving aside.
The nest's business is not mine.
I am the one who holds the road.
She walks third behind me.
We do not speak of this.

lines.zh: 我活着就是为了这一队
lines.en: I live for this column.
One antenna touch is enough.
My back to you is my answer.
To hold is to do my part.

lines.zh: 这一片猩红不会换主人
lines.en: This crimson does not change hands.
I go on ahead.
I lift it in my mandibles.
This should not be on the road.
I cannot carry any more.

lines.zh: 我们族群一动手，全都上。
lines.en: When our swarm fights, all join.
Those behind will pick it up.
This thing blocks the way.

lines.zh: 这重量对我的腿没影响
lines.en: This weight does nothing to my legs.
I take only what blocks the road.
I have blocked you.
You crossed our boundary.
Those behind have all stopped.
I go first.
I do not shout; it would frighten the young.
My position will not move.
Before we all strike, I test you.
This column answers to me.
My shell will hold.
You will not break through this layer.
I have stayed in front of you.
You move left; so do I.
My column has all arrived.
I watch your footing.
I am not quick, but I am steady.
The ones behind have closed in.

lines.zh: 这条路上没有别的出口
lines.en: There is no other exit on this road.
I hear you breathing.
My mandibles have not closed.
I count to five.
I drive my horns into your chest.
My mandibles clamp your bracer.
That horn butted hard.
My forelegs press your foot.
The blow pushed you back half a step.
My shell knocks your hand aside.
That blow was for the column.
Mandibles open, I come again.
My mandibles bite through your shoulder plate.

lines.zh: 我的上颚卡进你的护腕。
lines.en: My upper jaw locks onto your bracer.

lines.zh: 我从队伍的正面走出来
lines.en: I step out at the front of the column.
My shell looks darker under red light.
First I checked the road ahead.
Nineteen more are behind me.
I set my position.
I push a clump of grass aside with my horns.
This place needs someone to hold it.
I hear movement in the ground.
I close my mandibles and open them.
Old wounds ache in dull weather.
Fire passes over my plates, reddening them.

lines.zh: 落地时我的一条腿折了
lines.en: I land with one leg broken.
Water pours in through the seams.
The blast presses me into the grass.
Something lodges in my plate seam.
That force gets under my plates.
Too hungry to stand quite steady.

lines.zh: 雷打在甲上，我全身一僵
lines.en: Lightning strikes my armor and I lock up.
No ground here for me to stand on.
